clips.title: The story
paras: Menethil Bay carries Alliance traffic along the western coast of the Wetlands. The sheltered waters open into Baradin Bay, with Menethil Harbor to the north and Dun Morogh's steep cliffs to the south. Crocolisks prowl the shallows, and sunken vessels lie below.

Menethil Bay opens from the Wetlands into the Great Sea as part of Baradin Bay. Menethil Harbor lies to the north, Black Channel Marsh to the east, and Dun Morogh's coastal bluffs to the south. Crocolisks of many sizes prowl the shallow margins and marshy shores, making the water dangerous for travelers without a guide. The bay carries Alliance sea traffic, and near its mouth rests the ruined Flying Osprey, a warning of the wreckage beneath the surface.
